quests.title: The Narukami Trail

dialogue.t: "Grand Narukami Shrine"... Is this the place?
There are so many red doors. Do humans like red doors a lot?
They are at Asase Shrine too.
Oh, I understand now. So, this is a "torii gate." It's a place where birds live, right?
So the more torii gates there are, the more birds there are, right? Birds are a good thing. Humans are pretty smart, too.
Have you seen where Hibiki is?
There seems to be no one around...
Why don't we go up to the Grand Narukami Shrine and ask the shrine maidens there?
"Hibiki" should also be a shrine maiden... Maybe they would know something.
Meow, this shrine is really big, and there are a lot of humans too.
Wow! The Offering Box and racks are also very grand, no wonder so many people come here.
You should take some pointers. In the future, Asase Shrine will become like this.

dialogue.sit: Wait, why am I the one who has to take some pointers?

dialogue.t: However, I still don't see Hibiki anywhere.
Anyway, let's find someone to ask about "Hibiki."
Hello, Traveler from afar. Welcome to the Grand Narukami Shrine!
If you encounter any trouble or just want to make a wish, feel free to come here for a fortune slip. May the Electro Archon bless you.
We are not here to ask for a fortune slip, but there is something we want to ask you...
Ask me? Oh... go ahead then.
Hibiki from Asase Shrine? Could it be "Asase Hibiki"...
Yes! Hibiki is "Asase Hibiki." Human! Do you know Hibiki? Do you know where she is?
Hmmm... Huh!? How can this cat talk? Am I hearing things...
Humans, such ado about nothing... Is it so strange that I speak?
Do you know Hibiki? Do you know where she is?
It feels really strange to be questioned by a cat...
However, if you are really asking about that "Asase Hibiki," you've come to the wrong place...
Huh?
I have come across her name in the few well-preserved ancient texts of the shrine. She is the last successor of Asase Shrine...
About four to five hundred years ago, it was said that "The Yougou Three" Asase Hibiki, Kamuna Harunosuke, and Mikoshi Nagamasa once went to Mt. Yougou to learn under the Yougou Tengu.
During that time, Asase apprenticed at our shrine and also befriended the Kitsune Saiguu. However, in the end...

The three eventually parted ways after a "disaster" that was vague in their account. It is said that Kamuna Harunosuke crossed the sea and went to Liyue as he wanted to learn the more powerful "way of the adepti."
Mikoshi Nagamasa returned to Inazuma City to serve the Shogunate. As for Asase Hibiki...
Well, that's right. But because there is so little historical information available, the details are not very clear.
Hmm... she said four to five hundred years ago. So that means, Hibiki was someone from a long time ago.
So Neko's a cat that's 400 or 500 years old?
Meow? I'm not sure. What does "400 or 500 years old" mean?
I am not a human being. There aren't many things to worry about. I just know the rising of the sun, and then the moon. If I am in a bad mood, sleep is the best remedy.
Paimon's so envious...

dialogue.sit: Paimon, it's almost the same for you.

dialogue.t: Hey! How rude, Paimon is worried sick about {NICKNAME} every day.
You have said a lot of things that I do not understand. So, where is Hibiki?
With all due respect, I'm afraid that Asase Hibiki has...
Yes, that's right. Hibiki should have gone somewhere else.
That's true.
Oh well. Hibiki is still like a child, running around as she pleases.
Anyway, thank you, Miss Shrine Maiden!

dialogue.sit: Please excuse us, we'll be leaving now.

dialogue.t: Take care now. I'll be ready to help whenever you need me.
Let's have a rest here, I am tired.
But it's really the same as what Hibiki said.
The different islands are really completely different. Also, it turns out that the shrine can be on such a high mountain. Aren't humans afraid of heights?
My Asase Shrine is still better.
Where exactly is Hibiki, I wonder...

dialogue.sit: Do you still wish to continue looking for her?

dialogue.t: I am tired. Let's talk about it later.
There's still a "later"!?
That's for sure. Hibiki told me many, many stories. Stories about the beach, stories about the place with lots of trees, stories about the "Lady Kitsune."
I remember all these stories very well.
But the most important thing now is to return home. After all, Asase Shrine must have its Guuji.
In short, you will go back with me now.
Is something the matter?
Legend has it that Mikoshi Nagamasa has been working for the Shogunate, and it is said that he is extremely just and upright, even to the point of... being overly stubborn.
His bloodline has been passed down to this day. Most of the people in the city who have the surname Mikoshi today are his descendants.
Phew... finally back. After staying next to that shrine for a long time, my fur is curling up.
Thank you so much for your help. You are truly a rare and reliable human being, meow.
I will continue to take care of the shrine. When Hibiki returns, I will introduce you to her.
Meow, meow...
Ah, when will Hibiki come back...

quests.description: Neko, “Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine,” seems to have something she wants to do…
